subject: Picked up the shopping...
author: SUFFUR
body:
And saw a young lady and she was struggling with push chair and a trolly of shopping and thought I would help out, and get her shopping in a taxi while she dealt with child and chair.

The first cab pulled away??? But the next cab was cool, loaded up the cab and she got in the cab and left and I got in the Taxi behind, the driver went a bit funny because he thought I was with the woman and child, and got 10 minutes of how amazing I was, how bad that first cab was, and why was I not with the woman and child, lol, you should be in her cab. I just said it was the gentleman thing to do and it was sad that the first cabby was such a kcid, he must have been born invetro and never had a mother, lol.

Sad thing is I forgot the bread, so i'm going to get some grief from the old man, but I'll try and sort it later.

Did a walk around where I think the F1 road track is going to be, I have asked about but it's supposed to be a secret, but as I footed it about, I saw all these metal fences with serious concret bases, that could not really be climbed , that had downward facing flood lights onto the road, I would assume that was the route these cars will be travelling, but these roads are not are not that wide, just enough to do an over take, but at the speeds that they could be going, it's not really all that much room.

You can get your picture taken with the/a Williams F1 car, at the cost of S$10, but that not really my scene, though I might sneak back at night and take a few camera shots for the site, if I can work out how to do it?

Anyway I think it's time for a swim, so see you people's later.

Also forgot to buy a mouse for this lap top as it has a findlely nipple for motion control.

And my Burger King Wopper, had way too many pickles in it that I could not eat it even after I took them out, so going to have to do grill orders from now on, asking for no pickle. Why do they pickle the cucumbers anyway? Why not fresh cucumber to go with the tomatoes?

Some other stuff did happen but forgot all about it, I did a lot of wondering, when I remember, I'll jot it down.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: interesting.....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
😃 hey suffer nice to see that you arrived safe and sound..✈️...i must say its nice reading your blogs again i thought you had forgotten how to blog for a moment ..😢.... its amazing how a far away destination drags you back to where you belong.....its obvious that your missing live as youve blogged twice today already....not saying thats a bad thing i think its great its been really quiet in here over the last few days i thought everyone had gone but then you came back and lightened it all up again..⭐..i just hope you blog as much when you get back.....i do have to ask though why are you blogging your in a fantastic country which must have plenty of exciting things and places for you to go and see and do?..📷...saying that id probably be doing the same thing..💻...well i hope you enjoy what your doing now and i look forward to reading your next blog....HAVE FUN....🎵.....💰.....🎮.....

 

🌹....The only way to have a true friend...Is to be one....🌹
